data.one_liner: Helps create forms in Flutter by removing boilerplate code and reusing validation.
data.what_it_does: It provides ready-made form input fields integrated with FormBuilder to easily validate values, react to changes, and collect final user input without writing extensive manual boilerplate.
use_when: You are building data collection forms with multiple fields and need a unified way to manage state and validation.
You want standard input components like checkboxes, dropdowns, date-time pickers, and text fields wrapped for forms.
avoid_when: You prefer managing every FormField manually without a centralized FormBuilder state controller.
strengths: Removes significant boilerplate code for forms.
Includes many common ready-made input fields out-of-the-box.
Provides programmatic field value patching and validation invalidation.

alternatives.name: formz
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose formz if you prefer a modular, pure-Dart approach to independent form input validation without UI form builders.
